drivers.p: Brent is down 2.5% in a week. India imports most of its crude, so cheaper oil eases inflation, supports the rupee and helps oil users.
The rupee is at 94.24 per dollar, weaker than a week ago. A weak rupee helps exporters like IT but raises import costs.
